authorization: The owner authorizes additional evidence-bound mandatory repair capacity autonomously, without a separate owner permission request for each run. Daily verified shipment remains the objective; optional review loops are excluded.
allocation_rule: Use the existing mandatory_completion_grant to append only the exact deficits of the complete remaining correction, independent review, prepared capture, native, audio, scoring and delivery path before spending. Each original failed attempt owns at most one grant.
preservation_rule: Never change the original frozen envelope, cumulative charges, original failed evidence, independent grades, quality gates or shipped history. A capacity allocation is not a reservation, a review verdict or shipment authority.
progress_rule: Stop optional polish at its creative boundary. Mandatory corrections still require original independent rejection, the current complete blocker set, changed-input baselines and all recurrence and source-backed replacement checks.
